episodeTitle.en: When to invest in new acquisition channels | Adam Grenier (Uber, MasterClass)
episodeTitle.zh: 何时投资新获客渠道 | 亚当·格雷尼尔（Adam Grenier，优步、MasterClass）

guestBioOfficial.en: Adam Grenier is the former Head of Growth Marketing and Innovation at Uber, where he helped build Uber’s growth infrastructure from the ground up. He is also the former VP of Product and Marketing at Lambda School, and former VP of Marketing at MasterClass. These days, Adam is a growth and marketing advisor to many companies, as well as a teacher through Reforge. In today’s episode, Adam shares how to determine whether a new channel is worth exploring, the rise of the growth CMO, and how improv classes can improve team bonding and create a more positive, “yes” culture. He also speaks candidly about his own struggles with burnout and depression and shares some incredible tools that have helped him along the way.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 亚当·格雷尼尔曾任优步增长营销与创新部门主管，助力该公司从零到一搭建增长基础设施。他还曾担任Lambda School产品与营销副总裁，以及MasterClass营销副总裁。如今，亚当是多家公司的增长与营销顾问，同时通过Reforge授课。在本期节目中，亚当分享了如何判断新渠道是否值得探索、增长型CMO兴起的趋势，以及即兴表演课程如何促进团队凝聚力并营造更积极的“是”文化。他还坦诚谈及自己曾遭遇的职业倦怠与抑郁症，并分享了帮助他渡过难关的实用工具。

title.en: When to invest in new acquisition channels | Adam Grenier (Uber, MasterClass)
title.zh: 何时投资新获客渠道 | 亚当·格雷尼尔（Adam Grenier，优步、MasterClass）

summary.en: Adam lays out a three-ingredient framework for evaluating emerging acquisition channels: overlap between the channel's strengths and your customer and business needs (a green light only if they align), the channel's DNA (its stage and monetization strategy—matching theirs earns you an edge), and your own company DNA (risk appetite and existing channel mix). He advises testing with minimal resources, treating it like "fishing" and not letting it bleed past a quarter, noting only ~5% of new channels truly pan out. On the "Growth CMO," he argues product and marketing must be married at the hip and run with an agile, experimental mindset—traditional CMOs often fail because of that mismatch. He closes with a candid mental-health arc: burnout is often actually depression, distinguishable by whether you still show up for what you love, and therapy, a supportive partner, transparent friends, and meditation are what got him through.
summary.zh: Adam 提出评估新兴获客渠道的「三要素框架」：媒介优势是否与客户需求和公司目标重叠（重叠才亮绿灯）、渠道的 DNA（所处阶段、变现方式，匹配对方变现策略能拿到先发优势）、以及公司自身 DNA（风险偏好与现有渠道组合）。他建议用最小资源先「钓鱼」测试、别拖过一个季度，并提醒真正跑通的渠道只有约 5%。关于「增长型 CMO」，他认为产品与营销必须绑在一起、用敏捷和实验心态运作，传统 CMO 常因不匹配而失败。最后他坦诚分享心理健康历程：倦怠常其实是抑郁，区分在于你是否还愿意投入热爱的事；therapy、伴侣、透明朋友圈和冥想是撑过来的关键。
